summary: Corrected W3.1 Automatic Mutation-Triggered Live Vector Integration: materialized contracts and frozen acceptance for one applySystemArchitectureMutation write call -> automatic embeddingLifecycle from actual touched ids -> real approved Qwen embedding -> Neo4j vector-index queryability -> alignment response. The schema-valid pre-coding baseline is runner-owned in design/KG/test-failure-records.json: 37 total, 21 passed, 16 failed or missing, and 0 missing acceptance criteria. Default/offline W3.1 execution fails with W31_MUTATION_VECTOR_E2E_OPT_IN_REQUIRED until Coding/Repair runs with approved live opt-in and protected secrets.
